items.title: The cosimplicial Dold-Kan construction carries homotopic maps to homotopic maps
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file simplicial.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-homotopy-s-Q at source lines 5278-5288: for homotopic morphisms a, b : U to V of cosimplicial objects of an additive category, the induced maps on the associated cochain complexes s(U) to s(V) are homotopic, and over an abelian category the same holds for the Q-complexes. The proof at source lines 5290-5303 transfers the statement along the opposite-category functor: in the opposite category the maps a' and b' are homotopic by the push-out lemma, the simplicial version (lemma-homotopy-s-N) then gives homotopic maps s(a') and s(b'), and because s(a') is the opposite of s(a) one concludes by applying the double-opposite functor; the Q-case follows the same way using Q(U)' = N(U'). It is short; the substance is the correct bookkeeping of the opposite functors and the two identifications used to transfer the homotopy back.
